name: metadata-mutation-staleness-evidence
body: source statement (human): 'a re-scan must only ever be necessary after source-code changes; a metadata-only change (durable node/edge mutation, or transient plan/task/planned/feedback mutation) must never require a code re-scan — unnecessary re-scans are blocking on large codebases'. inconsistency (verified this session): after the plan-writer removed planned code FQNs (`apg plan rm planned …`), `apg_query` still returned them; planned code FQNs (e.g. `apg.session.start`) carry no `<project>/` prefix. root cause: the re-ingest path's `apg.artifacts.ArtifactDb.detach_delete_project` (src/artifacts.rs:336, invoked from `apg.artifacts.reingest_project_with` at src/artifacts.rs:836) drops only nodes whose FQN `STARTS WITH '<project>/'`; planned code FQNs have no project prefix, so they are never deleted, and `assembled_records` no longer re-merges them once the plan store drops the declaration → stale rows remain in `db.lbug` until a full `apg scan`. resolution: captured as the `graph-consistency` requirement tree — delete the exact FQN(s) the mutation touched instead of the `<project>/` prefix assumption, and keep `db.lbug` equal to the projection of its sources after every metadata mutation [autonomous, per human law].
